test_physics_construct_and_reload: test that mjcf Physics can be constructed from an MJCF model and reloaded to reset simulation time
test_physics_bind_elements_by_id: test binding MJCF elements like geom or joint to their MuJoCo physics IDs by namespace
test_physics_attribute_access: test reading and writing physics attributes like xpos or qpos through element bindings
test_physics_dirty_state: test that modifying qpos marks physics as dirty and triggers automatic recalculation on next data access
test_physics_bind_mocap_body: test binding mocap bodies to read and write mocap_pos and mocap_quat through physics bindings
